audit.why: 51.81% over 193 games — the smallest sample in this slice, so treat it as directional. Level 1 is even, 2-3 is a clean gate-Q window, and from 6 his resist-steal and healing amplification take over until items settle it back to even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Trundle|Skill|Jayce|Jayce|Trundle|Jayce|Jayce while whys[0] says 'Both of you are weak at level 1', whys[1] calls the gate-Q 'long-range artillery he can't answer', whys[3] says the 4-5 poke war 'tilts both ways', whys[5] says 'the level-6+ all-in is his', and whys[6] says items 'trade evenly'.
audit.why: Level 1 is handed to Trundle when the text calls it even, level 2 is called even when the text calls it artillery, and both item stages go to Jayce when the text gives the first to Trundle and calls the second even. Packet reference chart Skill|Jayce|Jayce|Skill|Trundle|Trundle|Skill matches every caption.
audit.corrected: Sides re-set to Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Trundle, Trundle, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is described only as something he 'closes with'. Riot: it 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming IMPASSABLE TERRAIN and slowing all nearby enemy units.' And Chomp is never identified as an auto-attack reset, which it is, on a flat 3.5s cooldown.
audit.why: The pillar is real terrain — it can wall your retreat and To the Skies!, your only dash, cannot cross it. That is the flagged dash-denial for this matchup and it turns his 21s E from a slow into a kill setup. Chomp being an auto reset means the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Pillar named as impassable terrain that blocks To the Skies! in mid; Chomp named as an auto-reset in early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page correctly says to buy anti-heal but calls the sustain 'his drain', which is not an ability. His healing is King's Tribute (P) — he heals a percent of max health whenever a unit dies near him — amplified by Frozen Domain's increased healing from all sources.
audit.why: Naming it changes a decision: minion deaths near Trundle are healing, so shoving a big wave into him and then brawling feeds his health bar. 'His drain' teaches nothing you can act on.
audit.corrected: King's Tribute and the Frozen Domain healing amplification named in late, with the wave-shove warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: early says 'don't hand him free Frost Bite value'. There is no ability called Frost Bite in Trundle's kit.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name — the calibration-list error class. His Q is Chomp; Frozen Domain is the W zone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Chomp 3.5s flat, Frozen Domain 18/17/16/15/14s, Pillar of Ice 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s, Subjugate 120/100/80s. The 21s Pillar and the 120s Subjugate are the two windows worth playing around; Chomp at 3.5s never is.
audit.corrected: 21s Pillar, 3.5s Chomp and the 120s Subjugate stated in mid.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even — his Q bite steals your AD if you walk into melee to last-hit, so farm with cannon Q-tips and don't hand him free Frost Bite value. Your window opens at 2-3: drop Acceleration Gate, fire Shock Blast through it for the accelerated long-range orb, and when he steps up to CS, swap to Hammer so the first hit shreds his Armor before you burst. The one rule: never brawl him on top of his Frozen Domain — fight at the range his whole kit hates.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely even — his Q, Chomp, is an auto-attack reset that bites off your AD if you walk into melee to last-hit, so farm with cannon Q-tips and hand him nothing. Your window opens at 2-3: drop Acceleration Gate, fire Shock Blast through it for the accelerated long-range orb, and when he steps up to CS, swap to Hammer so the first hit shreds his Armor before you burst. The one rule: never brawl him on top of his Frozen Domain — fight at the range his whole kit hates.

edits.before: Through 4-5 it tilts back and forth — he has Frozen Domain and the AD-stealing Q to contest your poke, so trade in bursts and reset, don't sit in a long fight he out-sustains. Level 6 is his window, not yours: Subjugate steals your resists and heals him while your R is just the stance-swap you already had, so respect every all-in once it's up and only commit on its cooldown. If he closes with a Pillar, Thundering Blow (Hammer E) knocks him back out of his own speed zone and resets the poke.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it tilts back and forth — Frozen Domain and the 3.5s Chomp reset contest your poke, so trade in bursts and reset instead of sitting in a fight he out-sustains. Pillar of Ice is real terrain, not a slow field: it walls your retreat and To the Skies! cannot cross it, so read the 21s E before you step up. Level 6 is his window, not yours: Subjugate steals your resists and heals him while your R is just the stance-swap, so commit only on its 120s cooldown, and Thundering Blow him back out of his own speed zone.

edits.before: This stays a coin-flip into items, and the deciding buy is anti-heal — without Executioner's or Oblivion Orb his drain plus Subjugate out-lasts your burst in any extended brawl, especially inside Frozen Domain. Keep it a poke war: gate-Q his approaches, swap-shred when he commits, and never let him pull you into a sustained melee fight on his terms. Your lethality keeps chunking him; his job is to make the fight long, so make it short.
edits.after: This stays a coin-flip into items, and the deciding buy is anti-heal — King's Tribute heals him a slice of max health off every unit that dies near him, and Frozen Domain amplifies all healing he receives, so without Executioner's or Oblivion Orb he out-lasts your burst. Never shove a big wave into him and then brawl: those minion deaths are his health bar. Keep it a poke war and make the fight short.

edits.before: Bait out your gate-Q, cross the Pillar gap, and stat-check you in any extended brawl he can drag out
edits.after: Wall your retreat with Pillar of Ice — impassable terrain To the Skies! cannot cross — then stat-check you

notes: 'Frost Bite' is not a Trundle ability. Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and denies To the Skies!, which was the flagged missing interaction and is the reason his 21s E is a kill setup rather than a slow. His healing is King's Tribute off nearby unit deaths, amplified by Frozen Domain — so shoving a wave into him before a brawl actively feeds him. Small sample (193 games), so the win-rate reading is directional only.
